This project estimates the number of homes that lost power in the Houston metropolitan area during the 2021 winter storms. It compares night light intensity between February 7th and February 16th, 2021, and maps the general locations of homes estimated to have lost power.

```{r}
# Load packages
library(tidyverse)
library(stars)
library(terra)
library(tmap)
```

## Compare night lights in Houston for both nights
```{r}
# Read in night light rasters
h08v05_preoutage <- rast("data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021038.h08v05.001.2021039064328.tif")
h08v06_preoutage <- rast('data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021038.h08v06.001.2021039064329.tif')
h08v05_postoutage <- rast('data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021047.h08v05.001.2021048091106.tif')
h08v06_postoutage <- rast('data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021047.h08v06.001.2021048091105.tif')

#Identify Houston area
houston_bbox <- st_bbox(c(xmin = -96.5, xmax = -94.5, ymin =29,ymax = 30.5), crs = 'EPSG:3083')
```
```{r}
# Join pre-outage files
if (crs(h08v06_preoutage) == crs(h08v05_preoutage)){
    return(invisible(NULL))
}else{
    warning("CRS do not match.  Transform before joining")
}

combined_preoutage <- merge(h08v05_preoutage, h08v06_preoutage) |> crop(houston_bbox)

## Join files for 02/16/2026
if (crs(h08v06_postoutage) == crs(h08v05_postoutage)){
    return(invisible(NULL))
}else{
    warning("CRS do not match.  Transform before joining")
}

combined_postoutage <- merge(h08v05_postoutage, h08v06_postoutage) |> crop(houston_bbox)

```
```{r}
# Visualize rasters

# Check if CRS match
if (crs(combined_postoutage) == crs(combined_preoutage)){
    return(invisible(NULL))
}else{
    warning("CRS do not match.  Transform before joining")
}

#Crop to Houston and merge rasters
combined_vis <- c(st_as_stars(crop(combined_preoutage, houston_bbox)), st_as_stars(crop(combined_postoutage, houston_bbox)))
names(combined_vis) <- c("Pre-outage (2/07/2021)", "Post-outage (2/16/2021)") 
combined_map <- merge(combined_vis) 

# Create comparison map
tm_shape(combined_map) +
    tm_raster(
        col.scale = tm_scale_continuous_log1p(values = "mako"),
        col.legend = tm_legend(
            title = 'Night light radiance (nW/cm^2/sr)',
            orientation = 'landscape')) +
    tm_title("Light intensity in Houston, Texas before and after 2021 winter storms")+
    tm_compass(position = c('right', 'top'), size = 0.75, color.dark = 'white', text.color = 'white', text.size = 0.5) +
    tm_scalebar(position = tm_pos_out('center', 'bottom')) +
    tm_layout(legend.outside = TRUE, legend.outside.postion = 'bottom')

```

## Identify total difference in night lights
```{r}
# Create a raster of the differnce in light
if (crs(combined_postoutage) == crs(combined_preoutage)){
    return(invisible(NULL))
}else{
    warning("CRS do not match.  Transform before joining")
}

 outage_diff <- (combined_preoutage - combined_postoutage)

# Reclassify outage as True (1) or False (NA)
outage_rcl<- matrix(c(-Inf, 200, NA,
                        200, Inf, 1),
                        ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)

outage_mask <- classify(outage_diff, rcl = outage_rcl) |> project('EPSG:3083') |> st_as_stars() |> st_as_sf() |> st_make_valid()
```

## Exclude light from roadways
```{r}
# Read in roadway data, specifying motorways, and condense
roads <- st_read(dsn = 'data/gis_osm_roads_free_1.gpkg/gis_osm_roads_free_1.gpkg', query ="SELECT * FROM gis_osm_roads_free_1 WHERE fclass='motorway'") |> st_transform('EPSG:3083')

#Create a buffer of area within 200m of roads
road_buffer <- st_buffer(roads, dist = 200) |> st_union() |> st_as_sf() |> st_make_valid()

# Exclude areas within 200 meters of a road from the mask
outage_exroad <- st_difference(outage_mask, road_buffer)
```

## Identify homes impacted by blackouts
```{r}
# Read in homes data
homes <- st_read(dsn = 'data/gis_osm_buildings_a_free_1.gpkg/gis_osm_buildings_a_free_1.gpkg', query ="SELECT *
FROM gis_osm_buildings_a_free_1
WHERE (type IS NULL AND name IS NULL)
OR type in ('residential', 'apartments', 'house', 'static_caravan', 'detached')") |> st_transform('EPSG:3083') |> st_as_sf() |> st_make_valid()

# Count homes where mask and homes overlap
blackout_homes <- st_intersection(homes, outage_exroad) |> st_point_on_surface()

print(paste('Approximately',length(unique(blackout_homes$osm_id)), 'homes lost power'))
```

# Map homes that lost power
```{r}
tm_basemap('OpenStreetMap') +
tm_shape(blackout_homes) +
    tm_dots(
        fill_alpha = 0.3,
        size = 0.05
    ) +
tm_title("Location of homes in Houston, TX estimated \nto have lost power in the 2021 winter storms") +
tm_compass(position = tm_pos_in('right', 'top')) +
tm_scalebar(position = tm_pos_out('center', 'bottom'))
```

## Conclusion

Between the nights of February 7th and February 16th, 2021, approximately 155,805 homes lost power. Homes were categorized as losing power if there was a drop of 200 nW or more in the surrouding 30m by 30m area between the two nights. However, this may underestimate the true number of homes affected. Locations within 200 meters of a major roadway were excluded to account for light from traffic, but this may exclude homes in close proximity to roadways. Additionally, homes generating limited lighting during the night of the initial satellite image (for example due to lighting preferences, activity timing, or absence from the home) may be excluded as a strong drop in lighting was not detected. Additionally, this analysis does not account for power loss during the last four days of the storm- our analysis stops at February 16th due to satellite data clarity constraints, excluding homes that may have lost power up until the end of the storms on February 20th. Further analysis can examine the role of socioecomonic or demographic factors in power loss or restoration.
